ownership: Both hands and minimum wrist skin; both boots. Excludes cloth cuff/trousers/body/head/staff. AH/AB namespaces avoid other owner IDs.

frames.R: anatomical right, actor -X, hand-0/foot-0, FRONT image left
frames.hand: -Y distal; +Z dorsal / -Z palmar; R thumb +X, L thumb -X
frames.foot: Y up, Z toe, inner toward actor X=0
frames.image: Do not mirror fixed pictures. Handed geometry requires corrected winding/normals and anatomical per-instance parameters.

registration_boundary: Lengths use the old source scale plus explicit author registration; images are not metrically calibrated. Shared curves/positions and right-hand bind mismatch remain to be resolved after all micro images are fixed. This is not a fabricated mesh or closed-surface test.
rig: 41 existing bones. Root/tip digit chains are not three independent phalanx bones. R source chains 3,2,1,0,4 must be distinguished from anatomical index,middle,ring,little,thumb and their intended lengths.

types.name: 掌中央曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 四指の付根へ広がる一枚の曲面。AH03/04の側縁、AH05の指間、AH06の付根半周、AH10の手首へ接続

types.name: 手背中央曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 中手骨の緩い起伏を持つ背面。掌の複製ではなく、同じ外周へ反対側から接続

types.name: 母指球・橈側曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 掌から母指付根へ回る一枚。AH01/02/09と母指AH06へ接続。球を重ねない

types.name: 小指球・尺側曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 掌と手背をつなぐ細長い側面。小指付根からAH10へ続く

types.name: 通常指間の鞍形曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 一手3枚。同じ型を幅・深さ登録し、隣接二指のAH06と掌/背へ接続

types.name: 指節の短い開放ロフト
types.shape_reuse_connections: 一手：通常四指の近位/中間8個＋母指近位1個。非円形断面と関節幅を個別登録、両端を共通輪郭へ

types.name: 指先・指腹の終端ロフト
types.shape_reuse_connections: 一手5個。指腹・扁平な爪床・閉じた先端。近位はAH06、爪床はAH08へ

types.name: 爪板の薄い曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 各指に1枚。爪床へ座る薄板で、下側・縁・厚みも必要。浮いた矩形にしない

types.name: 母指と示指の第一指間
types.shape_reuse_connections: AH05の単純拡大ではなく、母指対向を含む広い鞍形。AH03/02と母指・示指の付根へ

types.name: 手首の短い皮膚スリーブ
types.shape_reuse_connections: 掌の近位環からcloth cuffの下へ入るだけ。掌/背/側面と共通境界

types.name: 本底
types.shape_reuse_connections: 左右の足型を持つ連続した押出し形状。甲/腰革/踵後面の下縁、AB02、AB10へ

types.name: 踵ブロック
types.shape_reuse_connections: 低い閉じた押出し。AB01下面と接し、底面は支持面、AB11の4座を持つ

types.name: 甲の曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 足首前から爪先根元へ続く一枚。AB04/05/07と底周囲へ接続

types.name: 爪先を包む曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 扁平な爪先の丸みを作る一枚。AB03の切替縁と本底/縁帯へ。金属鎧を加えない

types.name: 内外の腰革曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 片靴2枚。同型でも内外の反り・土踏まずは別登録。甲/踵/脛/底へ

types.name: 踵後面の曲面
types.shape_reuse_connections: 後方を包む一枚。左右腰革・脛の後縁・底へ接続。背面縫い線は表面情報

types.name: 足首から脛の筒
types.shape_reuse_connections: くびれと屈曲余裕を持つ連続ロフト。AB03/05/06の足首環、AB08、AB09へ

types.name: 靴の履き口折返し
types.shape_reuse_connections: 内面・厚みを持つ短い折返し環。AB07とズボン下端の重なり。腕のcuffとは別

types.name: 巻き革の帯
types.shape_reuse_connections: 片靴：脛の逆巻き2本＋甲1本を計画。同じ薄い帯を各経路へ。交差部は厚みぶん持ち上げる

types.name: 底周囲の細い縁帯
types.shape_reuse_connections: 本底輪郭へ沿う一周の帯。甲などの下縁と共有。縫い位置を表面情報に含む

types.name: 踵底の留め釘頭
types.shape_reuse_connections: 原sole insetの4留め点を片靴4個。小さい薄円板、底から突出させない

required_views.digit: dorsal/palmar/side and both sections; fingertip pad/nail bed
required_views.nail: top, underside, thickness and free edge
required_views.sole_heel: top attachment, bottom, inner/outer side; fastener seat
required_views.boot_upper: outer and inner faces, all seam borders
required_views.strap_welt: flat front/back, section and registered route

necessary_contracts: Skin patches share exact boundary positions/index/weights/normals, including MCP/PIP/DIP/IP. UV duplication may not introduce geometric or skinning seams. Internal joints are not individually capped sausages or hidden with spheres.
Palm/back/thenar/ulnar/web network must connect all digit ports and the wrist loop. AH10 only supplies minimum cloth join skin.
Nail plate seats in fingertip bed. Boot lower perimeter and ankle ring are shared; knee/foot weights match neighboring pieces.
No boot/fastener protrudes below foot-local -108 mm. Sole/heel join has no air gap. Strap crossings lift by physical thickness; hidden seats are distinguished from unintended visible penetration.
Skin wrinkles/pores, leather grain/wear and stitch paths belong to each part surface/material, not whole-character image pasting or a mesh per pore/thread.
All micro reference sheets and contradiction repair precede fabrication. Final bytes/draws/memory/WebGL/device/PS4 appearance are unmeasured.
Complete and parts views show wrapping, but hidden strap routing and the opposite sole are authored counterpart construction, not observed source topology.
